title: Japan F1 Race Tour | Group Tour Package
highlights: Experience the Suzuka F1 Grand Prix - Option to attend one of the most iconic Formula 1 races in the world at the legendary Suzuka Circuit in Japan.
This Japan tour covers the country’s iconic highlights in one seamless journey, avoiding rushed days or frequent hotel changes.
The itinerary is designed for first-time Japan travellers, offering a balanced pace with guided sightseeing and ample free time to explore, shop, dine, or relax at one's own pace.
Optional experiences allow travelers to personalize their day, from the Suzuka F1 Grand Prix to Tokyo Disneyland, letting everyone choose the experiences that excite them most.
Discover the cultural treasures of Nara by visiting the famous Todai-ji Temple, home to the Great Buddha, and interacting with free-roaming deer at Nara Deer Park.
overview:
About the Tour:
﻿Experience the best of Japan on this 9-day journey combining culture, city life, natural beauty, and thrilling experiences. Begin in Osaka, where you can explore the city at your own pace or feel the adrenaline at the Suzuka F1 Grand Prix. Discover heritage at Osaka Castle, panoramic views from Umeda Sky Building, and the bustling Dotonbori streets. Take a scenic day trip to Kyoto, walking through the Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, admiring the Golden Pavilion, and wandering beneath the thousands of red torii gates at Fushimi Inari Shrine. Visit Nara’s Todai-ji Temple and friendly deer park, then enjoy the floral wonders of Nagoya’s Nabana no Sato. Explore Hakone with a ropeway over Owakudani Valley and a cruise on Lake Ashi with Mt. Fuji views. In Tokyo, experience Ueno Park, Sensō-ji, Shibuya Crossing, and immersive digital art at teamLab Planets, with a full day at leisure for Tokyo Disneyland or city exploration. Conclude your journey with a comfortable transfer to the airport, carrying memories of an unforgettable adventure across Japan.

know_before_you_go: Japan tourist visa assistance is included in the package; however, embassy fees, visa processing charges, travel insurance, and all applicable GST (5%) and TCS (5%) are not included and must be paid separately as per government regulations.

Group airport transfers are fixed with Osaka Kansai Airport (KIX) pick-ups at 3:00 PM and 7:00 PM on arrival day and Tokyo Haneda Airport drop at 7:00 AM on departure day; transfers outside these timings will be chargeable at INR 8,000 per vehicle (up to 4 guests).
Standard hotel check-in time across Japan is 15:00 and check-out is 10:00; early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed in advance.
Hotel rooms in Japan are compact by international standards, and triple occupancy (where applicable) may include a rollaway bed or sofa bed with limited luggage space.
All internal transfers, bullet train journeys, and sightseeing are conducted as part of a guided group tour, and guests must strictly adhere to meeting times to avoid missing scheduled services.
Meals are provided strictly as mentioned in the itinerary, meals are pre-set (no à la carte), and packed meals may be served on days with tight travel schedules.

Guests opting for F1 Race Experience, Hiroshima Day Tour, Tokyo Disneyland or DisneySea will do so at an additional cost and minimum group size, while non-opting guests will have leisure time at their own expense.
Tipping is mandatory for this tour at 750 Yen / 5 USD per person per day, payable directly during the tour and not included in the package cost.
Japan follows strict public etiquette, including no loud talking on public transport, no littering, and adherence to local rules at temples, shrines, and memorial sites.

The tour operator reserves the right to modify the sightseeing order or make internal route adjustments due to weather, crowd control, or operational requirements without affecting overall inclusions.
Travel insurance is not included but is strongly recommended, as medical and emergency expenses in Japan can be significantly high.
Guests are responsible for safeguarding their passports, cash, and valuables at all times, and the company will not be liable for loss, theft, or personal negligence.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the Land of the Rising Sun, Japan! Upon arrival at the Osaka Airport, board your transfer & get driven to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the city on your own. You can head out & dive into cinematic thrills at Universal Studios, one of Asia’s most famous theme parks or explore the Kuromon Ichiba Market, where Osaka’s reputation as the “Nation’s Kitchen” comes alive through fresh seafood & local delicacies.

days.title: Optional Activities Day in Osaka
days.desc: Today, enjoy a leisure day in Osaka, where you can feel the adrenaline rush at the Suzuka F1 Grand Prix as world-class drivers battle it out on one of Formula 1’s most iconic circuits, experiencing the speed, strategy, and atmosphere live from the stands. The roar of engines and high-speed action make this an unforgettable motorsport moment. Alternatively, you may choose to take the bullet train to Hiroshima to visit the Peace Memorial Park, Atomic Bomb Dome, and the scenic Itsukushima Shrine.

days.title: Osaka Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore the vibrant city of Osaka on a sightseeing tour. Begin with a photo stop at Osaka Castle, a symbol of Japan’s samurai heritage and one of the city’s most iconic landmarks. Continue to the Umeda Sky Building and soak in the panoramic views of Osaka’s striking skyline. Later, you can stroll through the lively Dotonbori district, famous for neon lights, street food, and local shopping. After a day of culture and city charm, get driven to your hotel in Osaka.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto & Arashiyama
days.desc: Today, get driven for a scenic day trip to Kyoto, Japan’s cultural heart. Begin with a visit to Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, where towering bamboo creates an otherworldly setting. After exploring, get driven to visit the iconic Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion), beautifully reflected in its surrounding pond and gardens. Next, explore the legendary Fushimi Inari Shrine, where you can stroll beneath thousands of vibrant red torii gates and capture amazing pictures. Later, get driven to the hotel in Osaka.

items.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour - Arashiyama Bamboo Grove + Kinkakuji Temple + Fushimi Inari Shrine

days.title: Transfer to Nagoya | En-Route Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Nara to explore its cultural treasures. Once there, visit the iconic Todai-ji Temple, home to the Great Buddha and a cornerstone of Japanese Buddhist heritage. Next, stroll through Nara Deer Park, where friendly sika deer roam freely, regarded as sacred messengers. Continue to Nagoya to experience Nabana no Sato, famed for its stunning floral displays and seasonal illuminations. Conclude the day with a transfer to your hotel in Nagoya for an overnight stay.

items.title: Trip to Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | En Route Hakone Ropeway & Lake Ashi Cruise
days.desc: After check-out, enjoy a scenic journey towards Tokyo, stopping en route at Sōunzan Station to board the Hakone Ropeway. During the ropeway ride, marvel at panoramic views of the volcanic Owakudani Valley, with its steaming vents, and catch amazing glimpses of Lake Ashi and Mount Fuji. Next, enjoy a scenic Lake Ashi cruise, offering iconic views of Mount Fuji from the water. After this experience, continue your journey to Tokyo. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel & enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: Hakone Ropeway Cable Car Tickets, Japan

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a full-day Tokyo sightseeing tour to explore the highlights of Tokyo. Begin at Ueno Park, a serene green space home to museums and historic shrines. Next, explore Sensō-ji Temple in Asakusa and stroll along Nakamise Street, lined with traditional shops. Also, capture photos at Tokyo Skytree before visiting Odaiba, home to the iconic Statue of Liberty replica. Conclude the day with teamLab Planets, an immersive digital art experience, before getting driven to your hotel.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Tokyo Local Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Day for Optional Tours in Tokyo
days.desc: Today, enjoy a leisure day in Tokyo, where you can explore the city at your own pace. You can head out & experience the magic of Tokyo Disneyland or DisneySea, where thrilling rides and enchanting shows bring beloved stories to life. Alternatively, discover Tokyo independently—stroll the upscale shopping streets of Ginza, witness the bustling energy of Shibuya Crossing, or unwind at a cozy café while soaking in the city’s vibrant atmosphere.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Tokyo and prepare for your journey home. Board your transfer to the airport, and upon reaching it, catch your flight back home, carrying unforgettable experiences of your Japan adventure—from the adrenaline of the Suzuka F1 Grand Prix and iconic landmarks of Kyoto and Osaka to the serene beauty of Hakone and the vibrant energy of Tokyo.
